map.准时到货率 = 准时批次 ÷ 总批次 × 100%；质量合格率 = 合格批次 ÷: On-time delivery rate = on-time lots ÷ total × 100%; quality pass rate = qualified lots ÷ total × 100%. With a measured intersection, use measured on-time-and-qualified ÷ total; without it, use on-time rate × pass rate as an independence assumption and label it as an estimate. Validation: counts are non-negative integers ≤ total; a measured intersection must lie between max(0, on-time + qualified − total) and min(on-time, qualified).
